name: structured_resources
description: Structured scientific resources for the workbench Resources tab: lipid structures (the single-chain fatty acids and Martini phospholipid stand-ins behind Gate C), reaction pathways (surfacing the generated Phase-3 reaction universe with its thermodynamics and honesty notes), paper references (the Martini/coarse-grained-MD set plus campaign citations), and the imported simulation engines. Each entry carries its citations.
evidence_dataset_qa_rule: No inferred rate constants from endpoint yields without a stated kinetic model; out-of-domain conditions carry a warning; original published values are preserved and a unit-normalized copy is provided alongside.

lipid-structure.name: Decanoic acid (C10:0, capric acid)
lipid-structure.summary: Short single-chain saturated fatty acid; near the lower chain-length bound for vesicle stability.
lipid-structure.charge_state: carboxylate, pKa ~4.8; protonated/deprotonated mix near the CAC sets bilayer stability
lipid-structure.role: single-chain amphiphile (endogenous protocell boundary; short-chain bound)
lipid-structure.notes: Fatty acid, NOT a phospholipid. Shorter chains raise the critical aggregation concentration and reduce bilayer stability.

lipid-structure.name: Dodecanoic acid (C12:0, lauric acid)
lipid-structure.summary: Single-chain saturated fatty acid; a model endogenous protocell amphiphile.
lipid-structure.charge_state: carboxylate, pKa ~4.8; protonation set by local pH
lipid-structure.notes: Fatty acid, NOT a phospholipid. Contrast the DLPC/DPPC bilayer stand-ins, which are phosphatidylcholines.

lipid-structure.name: Tetradecanoic acid (C14:0, myristic acid)
lipid-structure.summary: Single-chain saturated fatty acid; intermediate chain length.
lipid-structure.charge_state: carboxylate, pKa ~4.8; protonation set by local pH

lipid-structure.name: Hexadecanoic acid (C16:0, palmitic acid)
lipid-structure.summary: Long single-chain saturated fatty acid; near the upper chain-length bound used.
lipid-structure.charge_state: carboxylate, pKa ~4.8; protonation set by local pH
lipid-structure.role: single-chain amphiphile (endogenous protocell boundary; long-chain bound)
lipid-structure.notes: Fatty acid, NOT a phospholipid. Longer chains lower the CAC and give a thicker, lower-permeability bilayer.

lipid-structure.name: DLPC (dilauroyl-phosphatidylcholine, di-C12)
lipid-structure.summary: Two-chain phosphatidylcholine; the SHORT-chain Martini bilayer stand-in in the Gate C CG-MD.
lipid-structure.role: bilayer stand-in (short di-C12) for the composition->permeability->retention CG-MD (og-32)
lipid-structure.notes: This is a PHOSPHATIDYLCHOLINE Martini stand-in, NOT a fatty acid. Used as the short-chain bilayer in the Gate C MD: di-C12 gives bilayer thickness ~2.325 nm (vs DPPC di-C16 ~2.870 nm).

lipid-structure.name: DPPC (dipalmitoyl-phosphatidylcholine, di-C16)
lipid-structure.summary: Two-chain phosphatidylcholine; the LONG-chain Martini bilayer stand-in in the Gate C CG-MD.
lipid-structure.role: bilayer stand-in (long di-C16) for the composition->permeability->retention CG-MD (og-32)
lipid-structure.notes: PHOSPHATIDYLCHOLINE Martini stand-in, NOT a fatty acid. Long di-C16 gives a thicker bilayer (~2.870 nm) -> lower permeability (0.256) -> higher retention (0.661): composition sets permeability sets retention (og-32).

lipid-structure.name: POPE (palmitoyl-oleoyl-phosphatidylethanolamine)
lipid-structure.summary: Mixed-chain phosphatidylethanolamine; a biological-membrane reference lipid.
lipid-structure.role: biological reference lipid (one saturated C16 + one mono-unsaturated C18:1 oleoyl chain)

bead_mapping: palmitoyl + oleoyl tails (oleoyl carries a C4 double-bond bead)

lipid-structure.notes: Phosphatidylethanolamine; included as a biological-membrane reference point. The oleoyl double bond is the kink the Janke/Tieleman oleic-acid work characterizes.

reaction-pathway.name: The Phase-3 reaction universe
reaction-pathway.summary: The generated open C/H/O chemical network behind the campaign — rule-generated reactions with eQuilibrator thermodynamics.
reaction-pathway.description: A Wołos-2020-style rule-generated open chemical network over linear C/H/O skeletons (C1-C3 feedstock, products capped at C6), with eQuilibrator component-contribution transformed dG' at the Phase-1 posterior vent condition, catalyst-class requirements, and degradation/washout.
reaction-pathway.role_in_campaign: the shared chemistry Gates A/B build on (og-28 prebiotic reaction atlas operates on it)
reaction-pathway.campaign_tie: og-28 (reaction atlas coverage + zero-leakage gate); feeds og-29 (A2) and og-30 (Gate B)
honesty_notes: Every rate constant is hypothetical or extrapolated: the rules are real chemistry, the numbers are order-of-magnitude on the og-02 tick scale and are swept, never fitted.

50 of 1022 skeletons resolve to a formula-verified KEGG compound and carry the live eQuilibrator dG' (component contribution); the other 971 carry a group-additivity estimate (leave-one-out RMSE 7.2 kJ/mol).

Linear skeletons only: branched acids (citrate) and alkenes are outside the representation, so the full rTCA cannot close here; what the universe CAN contain is formose-type and reductive-carboxylation chemistry.
N/P-bearing rules deliberately excluded pending the expert's rule-set-scope decision.

reaction-pathway.name: Formose chemistry (linear autocatalysis route)
reaction-pathway.summary: Base-catalysed sugar-forming chemistry; tested as an A2 autocatalysis route and refuted under vent conditions.
reaction-pathway.description: Formaldehyde/glycolaldehyde aldol chemistry toward sugars; the canonical autocatalytic doubling is the glycolaldehyde-to-threose aldol. In the generated universe this is the aldol / formose_initiation / cannizzaro rule families over linear skeletons.
reaction-pathway.campaign_tie: og-29 (Gate A2, refuted): on a coefficient-free discriminator production is seed-independent (feed-driven, not self-amplified); the keystone doubling is condensation-favored so its splitting direction carries no net flux

keystone_rules.role: base-catalysed aldol addition (formose chain growth); includes the glycolaldehyde->threose doubling
the slow umpolung initiation 2 CH2O -> glycolaldehyde that seeds the cycle
aldehyde disproportionation (the classic formose side reaction / sink)

honesty_notes: Per-reaction dG' is the eQuilibrator value in reaction_universe (pH 9.38, I 0.25 M, 322 K); only 50/1022 skeletons carry the live value, the rest a group-additivity estimate.

reaction-pathway.name: Reductive carboxylation (rTCA-type steps)
reaction-pathway.summary: CO2-fixing carboxylations in the generated universe; uphill at vent conditions, and the full branched rTCA cannot close in a linear-skeleton representation.
reaction-pathway.description: CO2 + H2 reductive carboxylations (ferredoxin-type chemistry in real rTCA), plus the initial co2_reduction to formate. In the generated universe these are the carboxylate_reductive / carboxylate_alpha / co2_reduction rule families; the reductive direction is uphill at vent concentrations and its rate follows by detailed balance from the downhill oxidative-decarboxylation.
reaction-pathway.role_in_campaign: A1 carbon-fixing chemistry; the rTCA-type steps tested for A2 autocatalysis
reaction-pathway.campaign_tie: og-rtca (Gate A2, refuted): a seeded reductive-TCA cycle washes out under vent H2 because the reductive carboxylations run uphill (the same reason real rTCA uses ferredoxin, not H2); the FULL branched rTCA cannot close in this linear-skeleton universe (honesty_note) and is tested in og-rtca's own composite

keystone_rules.note: uphill at vent; rate by detailed balance from the downhill oxidative-decarboxylation direction

keystone_rules.role: enol carboxylation, e.g. pyruvate + CO2 -> oxaloacetate

honesty_notes: Linear skeletons only: the full branched rTCA (citrate) cannot close here; the universe holds the reductive-carboxylation steps, not the closed cycle.
50/1022 skeletons carry the live eQuilibrator dG'; the rest a group-additivity estimate.

reaction-pathway.name: The A1 sustained carbon-fixing network
reaction-pathway.summary: The connected carbon-fixing subnetwork that persists at vent-realistic feeds inside a concentrating pore (Gate A1 / Gate B).
reaction-pathway.description: The subset of the reaction universe that ignites and sustains a nonzero net carbon throughput under continuous feed + washout — a connected network rather than isolated one-offs. In a well-mixed system the six-carbon network ignites only at ~20x the vent-posterior feed; a concentrating mineral pore closes that gap.
reaction-pathway.role_in_campaign: Gate A1 (network persistence, qualified) and Gate B (spatial rescue, met)
reaction-pathway.campaign_tie: og-29 (the network needs ~20x well-mixed feed) + og-30 (a pore at porosity ~0.88 ignites it at the vent-posterior feed: net carbon flux +4.49e-4, connected, where a matched well-mixed control stays dead); persists within a bounded porosity window ~0.80-0.90
honesty_notes: Persistence is qualified: the network holds inside a pore, not in free solution, within a bounded, somewhat brittle porosity window.
The metabolism is carbon-fixing, NOT autocatalytic (A2 is refuted under vent conditions).

reaction-pathway.name: Amphiphile C10-C16 elongation
reaction-pathway.summary: Endogenous synthesis of fatty-acid amphiphiles from the reduced-carbon pool — the membrane the metabolism makes for itself (Gate C).
reaction-pathway.description: Chain-extension, headgroup and competing-hydrolysis reactions that build single-chain fatty-acid amphiphiles (C10-C16) from the campaign's own reduced-carbon products (acetate + formate), rather than from an injected amphiphile pool.
reaction-pathway.role_in_campaign: Gate C self-compartmentation (the 'makes a membrane' chemistry)
reaction-pathway.campaign_tie: og-31 AmphiphileSynthesisProcess (the boundary forms from acetate+formate-derived amphiphile; ablating synthesis gives no boundary) + og-32 (composition sets permeability sets retention)

data_source.note: NOT in reaction_universe — this is og-31's separate AmphiphileSynthesisProcess composite; recorded here as the pathway view.

honesty_notes: Modeled in og-31/og-32 as an explicit synthesis composite, not part of the generated reaction_universe.

imported-engine.name: PHREEQC (phreeqpython)
imported-engine.summary: Aqueous geochemical speciation and mineral equilibrium for the vent interface.
imported-engine.wraps: aqueous speciation + mineral saturation / precipitation (phreeqpython + llnl.dat)
imported-engine.role: vent geochemistry — pH/redox endmembers, carbonate saturation index, serpentinization products

imported-engine.name: FiPy
imported-engine.summary: Finite-volume PDE solver for reactive transport and the thermophoretic trap.
imported-engine.role: reactive transport — vent cross-section, thermophoretic enrichment, pore concentration

imported-engine.name: eQuilibrator
imported-engine.summary: Component-contribution transformed Gibbs energies for the reaction universe.
imported-engine.role: per-reaction dG' at the vent condition (pH 9.38, I 0.25 M, 322 K) across the reaction universe

evidence-dataset.name: Muchowska 2019 — nonenzymatic rTCA-like network yields
evidence-dataset.summary: Metal-promoted nonenzymatic synthesis of rTCA-cycle intermediates; the network-chemistry evidence anchor.

model_prediction.output: net carbon flux + autocatalytic gain (seed-independence discriminator)

evidence-dataset.control_arm: no-metal / no-CO2 controls (as in the paper)
evidence-dataset.digitization_provenance: main-text yields; not pixel-digitized from figures
evidence-dataset.caution: Yields/endpoints are NOT kinetic constants — do not infer rate constants from them without a stated kinetic model.

evidence-dataset.name: Jordan 2019 — mixed-amphiphile vesicle assembly windows
evidence-dataset.summary: Prebiotic mixed amphiphiles self-assemble into vesicles across a salt / pH / temperature window; the amphiphile-emergence evidence anchor.

original_measurement.quantity: aggregation-competent window (chain length / salt / pH / divalent / temperature)

model_prediction.output: composition -> permeability -> retention window (og-31 retention/access; og-32 MD-informed)

evidence-dataset.control_arm: composition / condition variation across the assembly window (as in the paper)
evidence-dataset.digitization_provenance: assembly windows from main figures; not pixel-digitized
evidence-dataset.caution: Lab amphiphile mixtures demonstrate assembly, NOT endogenous synthesis — they do not establish that the campaign's own chemistry produces these amphiphiles.

evidence-dataset.name: Baaske 2007 — thermophoretic accumulation in hydrothermal pores
evidence-dataset.summary: Thermophoresis + convection drive extreme molecular accumulation in model pore systems; the spatial-concentration evidence anchor.
evidence-dataset.source_figure_table: accumulation factor vs pore geometry (main figures)

original_measurement.quantity: molecular accumulation factor vs pore geometry

model_prediction.value: enrichment ~23x at porosity 0.88 (og-30); og-03 restated at the resolvable Peclet, NOT the >=1e6 fold

evidence-dataset.control_arm: open / plugged / well-mixed pore controls (the Baaske regimes)
evidence-dataset.digitization_provenance: accumulation regimes from main figures; not pixel-digitized
evidence-dataset.caution: The extreme accumulation is a GEOMETRY-DEPENDENT model output, not a universal constant; og-03 restated localization at the resolvable Peclet (the resolved FEM does not confirm the >=1e6 fold above Pe ~13).

evidence-dataset.name: Souza 2021 — Martini 3 force field (CG-MD parameters)
evidence-dataset.summary: The Martini 3 general-purpose coarse-grained force field; the parameter basis for the membrane-MD property library (M1-M4).

original_measurement.quantity: CG bead types + bonded/nonbonded parameters + validation observables

model_prediction.value: di-C16 2.870 nm / di-C12 2.325 nm -> permeability 0.256 -> retention 0.661

evidence-dataset.control_arm: composition comparison (di-C12 vs di-C16) + no-endogenous-membrane ablation (og-32)
evidence-dataset.digitization_provenance: published parameter set (Nature Methods + SI / Martini portal)
evidence-dataset.license_access: subscription (Nature Methods); parameters open via cgmartini.nl
evidence-dataset.caution: A general CG force field — nonstandard prebiotic amphiphiles (single-chain fatty acids, titratable carboxylates) need specific validation; the Martini-3-building-block fatty-acid defs are a proposed_input, not published lipidome entries.
